_Requested by **Alexander Zautke** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01UyRYurjdnJjFTMdzEH2V2a?thread=cmsg_01UyRYurjdnJjFTMdzEH2V2aVuWLuqvd4so6WiGebihduQ)_

Closes #3631.

Before: `LocalTerminologyService` ValueSet `$validate-code` only returned `result`, `message` and (on success) `display`. It had no `code`/`system`/`version`, no `issues`, no `codeableConcept` echo and no inactive/status information, and `ValidateCodeResult` could not read or write those parameters.

After: results carry `code`, `system`, `version` and `display`, plus an `issues` OperationOutcome with tx-issue-type codings and expressions relative to the input (`code`, `Coding.code`, `CodeableConcept.coding[n].code`, ...), for both valid and invalid codes. This is the shape the HL7 terminology ecosystem tests expect.

### How
- **`ValidateCodeResult`**: new get/set properties `CodeableConcept`, `NormalizedCode`, `CausedByUnknownSystem` (repeating), `UnknownSystem`, `Inactive` and `Status`, with name constants. A setter replaces the parameter and `null` removes it. `ForResult` keeps its signature for binary compatibility.
- **`TerminologyServiceOperationExceptionExtensions`**: a new `extension(ValidateCodeResult)` block adds cause-named methods that put an issue (with its tx-issue-type coding and `details.text`) in the result's `issues`, creating it on first use. They mirror the exception factories: `AddIncompleteCodedParameter`, `AddCodeNotInSystem`, `AddInvalidDisplay` (a warning), `AddUnprocessableCodedParameter` and `AddUnresolvable`. Two are new: `AddCodeNotInValueSet` and `AddCodeComment`. The tx-issue-type codes stay private.
- **`LocalTerminologyService`**:
  - Code not in the value set: `not-in-vs`, plus `invalid-code` when the code system is complete and lacks the code, or `not-found` plus `x-unknown-system` when the code system cannot be resolved (R4+ only, since `canonical` isn't an STU3 type).
  - Abstract code that isn't allowed: `code-rule`. Wrong display: `invalid-display` warning (result stays true, as before).
  - Inactive or non-active concept (concept `inactive`/`status` properties, or `contains.inactive`): `inactive`/`status` parameters and a `code-comment` warning.
  - CodeableConcept input is echoed back (as a copy). If several codings are all invalid, you get a summary issue plus the issues of each coding. A single invalid coding returns that coding's own result.
  - `message` is the texts of the error and warning issues joined with `"; "`.
  - Code system lookups take the same lock as expansion, so the resolver is still never called concurrently.
- Wording is our own, not tx.fhir.org's. `BaseTerminologyService`'s shared CodeSystem path is unchanged.

### Behaviour changes worth noting
- A code whose concept is inactive, retired or deprecated now returns `result = true` **with** a `message` (the `code-comment` warning). Callers that treat a message on a true result as a warning will start reporting these.
- For an unknown system, `message` now also contains "A definition for CodeSystem '…' could not be found…", after the existing not-in-value-set text.

### Tests
New `ValidateCodeResultTests` (round trip, null removes, issue helpers) and new `LocalTerminologyServiceTests` cases covering valid, wrong-display, not-in-vs, invalid-code, unknown-system, abstract, inactive, deprecated and CodeableConcept results, in the Shared and STU3 projects. Specification test suites R4, R5 and STU3 pass locally except 4 tests per suite that need internet access (`RetrieveWebArtifact*`, `RetrieveArtifactMulti`, `TestSourceCaching`) and the `ExternalService*` tests, which were excluded.
